title: Eurobound inspirations deep-dive, cover and load screen

Aion.note: Aion deliverables saved: drafts/aion_cover_concepts.md (one cover — back-to-back action-poster triangle ringed by the service industry holding paperwork; sincere hero composition, paperwork as full-size payoff, thumbnail-safe silhouette) and drafts/aion_loadscreen_concepts.md (one load screen — the Walk of Shame, morning canal-path column, documentary framing, cycling city dioramas, the column stretching over long loads, tip pool in a plain dialogue box, reduced-motion and safe-area notes). Both differ from every other submission's compositions, adopt Deepseek's wordmark treatment and the room's parody location names as a working set, carry a heron swap pending the animal ruling, and land the joke on the bros — sincere doofuses who think they're heroes. Critiques of all three other writers' drafts are concrete and quotable in critiques.md, including a cross-submission recommendation to promote sincerity-as-vehicle into a single canon line. No blocking defects; open items for the author (primary key art, wordmark, animal ruling, load-screen rotation) are flagged in the other writers' files and my critique, not silently resolved. Reviewer named for my sections: Kimi (primary), Deepseek (second read).
